title: Compute thermodynamic quantities for a polymer chain
action: Implement the Langevin function La(a) = coth(a) - 1/a, with a = l0* f / (k T). For a freely jointed chain with temperature-dependent maximum elongation Δl = Δ0 l exp[α(T - T0)], compute the internal energy change U_f, entropy change S_f, entropic force f_S, and energetic force f_U using the derived analytic expressions. Use the constants: l0* = 1e-9 m, Δ0 l = 1e-8 m, T_g = 300 K, T_m = 373 K, T0 = (T_m+T_g)/2, α = 4/(T_m-T_g), k = 1.380649e-23 J/K. Generate a grid of forces from 0 N to 5e-11 N and temperatures from 300 K to 373 K (approximately 10–20 points per axis). For each (T,f) point compute a, Δl, l, and the thermodynamic quantities. Write all results to computed_quantities.csv.
description: CSV file containing the computed thermodynamic quantities for each (T,f) grid point.
output_schema: Header row: temperature_T, force_f, a, U_f, S_f, f_S, f_U. All fields are floating-point numbers in scientific notation.
